description: An unavailable credential store names OPENPROSE_API_KEY in both Detail and Action, with no status line.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: CREDENTIAL_STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The operating system credential store is unavailable.
Detail: the OS credential store is unavailable; set OPENPROSE_API_KEY for this command
Action: Set OPENPROSE_API_KEY for this command, or unlock or configure the operating system credential store, then retry.
